contract_digest_equation.equation: SHA256(UTF8(canonical_json(schema))) where schema is the row's full closed schema object {schema_version, owner, fields}: every ordered field descriptor binds its exact name, type, required optionality, and where applicable nonempty, constant, enum, format, minimum, maximum, min_items, max_items, max_length, items, fields, ref, ref_digest, provenance, value_role, derivation, variants, and ordering
contract_digest_equation.schema_object_rule: descriptor vocabulary is closed: name, type, required, nonempty, constant, enum, format, minimum, maximum, min_items, max_items, max_length, items, fields, ref, ref_digest, provenance, value_role, derivation, variants, ordering; types are string, integer, boolean, object, array; formats are sha256_hex, https_url; provenance values are server_derived, user_supplied, owner_state; value_role values are control, identifier, display_text, web_url; every object descriptor carries either closed fields or an immutable exact-version-and-digest ref+ref_digest reference (adopted contract, retained_contract_pins literal, or an external retained spec pinned by exact schema digest); every array descriptor carries closed items; adding an enum value or deleting a derivation rule changes the schema bytes and therefore the contract_digest
type_strictness: a copied digest is never proof without rebuilding its source object
contract_digest_equation.consumption_rule: implementations consume the manifest constants and may not retype these tables independently
